traditional: No classical doctrine: Neptune is a modern planet. This combination is modern/cyclic only.

modern.blend: Identity meets imagination and idealism. Heightened sensitivity, imagination, and a pull toward the ideal.
modern.harmonious: Imaginative and compassionate; creative and charitable directions come naturally.
modern.hard: Susceptibility to illusion and escapism, and to the rescuer/rescued dynamic. The self can get foggy.
modern.business: Creative or service-oriented directions; guard against self-deception and being played.
